description: Create or update an SMS template. Every new version is reviewed before use, usually by AI in seconds. Prefer typed fields, checked at every send: {nome}/{name}, {attivita}/{business}, {indirizzo}/{address}, {ordine}/{order}, {codice}/{code}, {data}/{date} DD/MM/YYYY, {ora}/{time} HH:MM, {importo}/{amount}, {link}/{url} (only URLs on the verified site, see verify_site). Any other field name is free text and is reviewed (usually in seconds, sometimes by a person). No phone numbers: write "reply to this SMS" (in the message language), replies come back to you. status pending: being reviewed, check template_requests again after a few seconds; rejected: review_reason says what to change.
name: submit_template
